headline: Dongshan Precision Hong Kong IPO Undersubscribed Amid Weak Demand
summary: Chinese printed circuit board maker Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing saw its retail IPO undersubscribed with fewer than 10,000 applicants.
why: Initial public offerings provide liquidity for private enterprises and gauge investor appetite for equities.

impacts.name: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co
impacts.why: An undersubscribed public offering can limit capital raising goals and depress initial secondary market trading.
